---
title: One source. Two views.
---

A nine-slide example introduces the workflow and demonstrates columns, a card,
incremental bullets, code steps, a zoomable SVG and inline presenter notes.
**Nocturne** is its declared theme, with automatic light/dark selection in the
source. The links here open fixed light and dark examples.

```{=html}
<div class="home-grid example-links">
<article><span class="eyebrow">Audience</span><h2>Share the slides</h2><p>Outline, navigation and presentation interactions. Actual speaking cues are removed from this file.</p><p><a href="_generated/decks/nocturne/light/index.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open light slides ↗</a> · <a href="_generated/decks/nocturne/dark/index.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Dark slides ↗</a></p></article>
<article><span class="eyebrow">Presenter</span><h2>Keep the cues close</h2><p>The same slides, with a notes panel for each slide. Audience and presenter windows navigate independently.</p><p><a href="_generated/decks/nocturne/light/presenter.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open light presenter ↗</a> · <a href="_generated/decks/nocturne/dark/presenter.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Dark presenter ↗</a></p></article>
</div>
```

## Try the interactions

- Slide 4: use **Next** or **Space** to reveal the argument one point at a time.
- Slide 5: step through the code emphasis.
- Slide 6: click the diagram to zoom, then close it with **Escape**.
- Slide 7: compare the visible notes syntax with the actual cues in presenter view.
- Press **O** for the overview. Use the outline to jump to a slide.

## Edit the source

```{=html}
<p class="download-links"><a href="_generated/source/index.qmd.txt" download="index.qmd">Download Markdown</a> · <a href="_generated/source/source.css.txt" download="source.css">Download CSS</a> · <a href="_generated/source/two-views.svg" download="two-views.svg">Download SVG</a></p>
```

Save the Markdown as `index.qmd`, the CSS beside it as `source.css`, and the SVG
as `assets/two-views.svg`. The complete editable example is also committed under
`decks/example/` in the repository. Render it with:

```sh
just render decks/example/index.qmd
```

The Markdown download includes the public example's speaking cues. See
[the authoring guide](build-a-deck-from-markdown.md) for your own decks, or
[compare this deck across themes](compare.qmd).
